SI Fig. 4 (vector marks, re-read 2026-09-29) plots this point at relative error 1.917e-3 against -76.308, i.e. -76.1617 total. Upload c810bdc (jrm874, 2022-07-16): -76.162 | 0.006 | 0.14(2), never changed; energy_variance upload-only. M6/M8 settled from the source: a sampled VMC energy ('General expectation values and gradients of the objective function are computed using Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling', main text Sec. 2 C, p. 5) whose stored sigma is the uploader's Monte Carlo error; units.mjs counts the row deterministic only because 'Soft mean-field constraint' matches /mean[- ]field/ (units.mjs line 20), which changes nothing while sigma is stored (isSampled is consulted only when sigma is null). Venue PNAS, peer reviewed ('Edited by Angel Rubio ... received December 6, 2021; accepted June 28, 2022'; 'This article is a PNAS Direct Submission'); the imported row carries no peer_reviewed field (loader-level, see report). compute.reported_as: We typically choose tau = 0.01 in this work, with which we have verified that the Trotter error is below the targeted statistical errors. || In this section, we present results at half-filling. As mentioned, the AFQMC results are numerically exact, as the sign problem is absent because of the particle-hole symmetry. We use a combination of the path-integral approach [40] and the random walk approach [25]. || In this work, we use a special form of the generalized Hartree-Fock (GHF) [34] wave function as TWF in the AFQMC calculations. This will increase the computation time by a factor of 2 to 4 in different portions of algorithm, because now the Slater determinant of up and down spin are coupled. || Earlier calculations were carried out at the Oak Ridge Leadership Computing Facility at the Oak Ridge National Laboratory. Most of the calculations were carried out at the Extreme Science and Engineering Discovery Environment (XSEDE), which is supported by National Science Foundation Grant No. ACI-1053575, and the computational facilities at the College of William and Mary.
compute.source: Sec. II B (Trotter step); Sec. IV Results at half filling; Sec. III B (GHF trial wave function); Acknowledgments; energies from Appendix Table IV, arXiv:1605.09421 (compute pass 2026-09-16)
compute.note: Half-filling AFQMC data of Appendix Table IV (PBC and PBC-APBC, 4x4 to 16x16, U = 2-8). No walker counts, projection times, sample/block counts, core counts, core-hours or wall-clock are stated anywhere for these runs; the only quantitative method setting is the Trotter step tau = 0.01 (with a tau -> 0 extrapolation used only for the TABC data). The GHF trial-wave-function remark is a relative cost (factor 2-4 in computation time), not an absolute one.
